title: Writing Code vs. Shipping Code: Productivity Effects Across Generations of AI Coding Tools
discussion_signal: The post interprets the NBER result as an end-to-end throughput problem: AI increases coding activity, but gains attenuate through integration, review, release, and actual use. Its counter-signal is that local task acceleration can create a larger queue without changing the bottleneck that determines useful software output.
linked_research_question: Where do AI coding gains disappear between writing code, integrating it, shipping releases, and producing software that people actually use?
limits: Individual interpretation of an NBER working paper
The post adds a systems lens but not an independent causal estimate
Software output is not equivalent to organizational or economic value
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
